title: Neden — Language learning inside IINA
description: Built a macOS video-player plugin that lets learners click subtitle words for meanings, select phrases for contextual AI explanations, and ask follow-up questions without leaving the video.
seoTitle: Neden | AI Language Learning in IINA | Hanif Carroll
seoDescription: Building an IINA plugin for word lookup and contextual AI explanations, with a TypeScript interface, Swift streaming helper, and macOS Keychain storage.
role: Product design, plugin development, and native integration
problem: Looking up unfamiliar dialogue in another app takes the learner away from the video and subtitles.
A translation can give the overall meaning without explaining how the words and grammar produce it.
solution: Made external subtitles selectable inside IINA, with quick word lookup and a sidebar for phrase explanations and follow-up questions.
Built a Swift helper for incremental HTTPS responses and kept playback, conversation, and request ownership in the TypeScript plugin.
Stored provider keys in macOS Keychain. Phrase requests include the selected text, nearby subtitle cues, and conversation history.
result: A working pre-release plugin used in my own Turkish-learning workflow.
Public MIT-licensed source and a locally installable package, with broader native testing still to do.
